technical_and_design_decisions: Use Java 17+ and Spring Boot / Spring Cloud Stream / Spring Shell paradigms for module management and CLI commands.
Implement `ModuleRegistry` as a SPI/service interface with an in-memory/persistent back-end mapping module names and types to Maven coordinates.
Extend `AetherModuleResolver` with an explicit offline flag passed down to the underlying Eclipse Aether RepositorySystemSession.
Refactor uber-jar classloading behavior using Spring Boot Launcher customization or explicit classpath ordering rules to ensure bundled jars take precedence over external libraries.
Extract `@RedisRule` and related test infrastructure into a standalone test-commons artifact for multi-module reuse.
Port the Spring XD SFTP module to Spring Cloud Stream by converting XD-specific channel adapters to Spring Cloud Stream `@EnableBinding` / functional stream definitions.
assumptions: Development and testing will be performed by a single developer familiar with Spring Framework, Spring Cloud Data Flow, Spring Cloud Stream, and Eclipse Aether.
Build tools used across repositories are Maven and/or Gradle with multi-module support.
SFTP test infrastructure (e.g., embedded SFTP server or testcontainers) is available for integration testing of the ported SFTP module.
Existing shell/CLI infrastructure (e.g., Spring Shell) is present in the target repo to host the new module management commands.

activities.activity_description: Analyze existing s-c-d, s-c-s, and Spring XD codebases; formulate detailed design for ModuleRegistry, classloader isolation, and CLI commands integration.
Modify uber-jar packaging and classloading behavior to prevent external libraries from overriding core libraries packaged inside the executable jar.

activities.activity_name: U2: Extract External Library to Separate Project
activities.activity_description: Refactor external library components out of the core project into a dedicated subproject/module within the s-c-d repository and update build descriptors.

activities.activity_name: U3: Port SFTP Module from Spring XD to s-c-s Repo
activities.activity_description: Port SFTP source module code, dependencies, configurations, and integration tests from Spring XD to the Spring Cloud Stream repository format.

activities.activity_name: U4: Extract RedisRule Contract to Test Commons
activities.activity_description: Create a new project/module to isolate @RedisRule and associated Redis testing utilities so they can be reused across test suites.

activities.activity_name: U5: Foundation Infrastructure for OOTB Processor Modules
activities.activity_description: Build core infrastructure in s-c-d to register, resolve, and manage out-of-the-box processor modules from the s-c-s-m repository.

activities.activity_name: U6: Enable Offline Mode in AetherModuleResolver
activities.activity_description: Enhance AetherModuleResolver configuration to support offline resolution, bypassing remote repository network calls and relying on local Maven cache.
Create ModuleRegistry interface and standard implementation to manage lookup, mapping, and resolution of module coordinates by name and type.

activities.activity_name: U8: Implement Module Management CLI Commands
activities.activity_description: Implement 'module info', 'module list', 'module register', and 'module unregister' commands in the shell CLI, delegating to ModuleRegistry.
Perform end-to-end integration testing across module registration, offline Aether resolution, SFTP streaming, and CLI shell interactions; update documentation.
